start: Signed in as owner, online; member page with a receipt for a plan that is not cancelled

steps.action: In the payments list tap 'Cancel receipt' on the row
user_sees: Sheet 'Cancel this receipt?'

'Receipt <number> for <amount>, taken on <day>, will no longer count as money received. The amount is added back to this member’s dues. The receipt stays in the list, marked cancelled. Its number is never used again.'
'Reason' box with the example 'Entered twice' and 'Saved with the receipt, so it is clear months later.'
Red 'Cancel receipt' button that cannot be pressed yet; 'Keep it' beside it
must_not: The receipt cancelled by the first tap, with no question
A wrong receipt number, amount or day in the sentence

user_sees: 'Cancelling…'
The sheet closes
'Receipt cancelled. The amount is back in their dues.'
The row stays, amount struck through, no Cancel button on it
The member’s due is higher by that amount
must_not: The row deleted
The amount still in the day’s collection
The due unchanged

start: Signed in as owner; Money → Collections, the list of receipts

steps.action: Tap 'Cancel receipt' on a row (table on a laptop, card on a phone)
user_sees: The same sheet with the same words
must_not: A different rule or wording from the member page

user_sees: 'Receipt cancelled. The amount is back in their dues.'
The collection total for that day falls by the amount
must_not: The total unchanged until a reload

start: Receipt of a plan that was later cancelled (other kind)

user_sees: '… will no longer count as money received. That membership is cancelled, so nothing is added back to their dues. The receipt stays in the list, marked cancelled. Its number is never used again.'
must_not: A promise that the amount returns to dues

user_sees: 'Receipt cancelled.' with no word about dues
Dues unchanged
must_not: A due appearing for a cancelled plan

start: Receipt that is not for a membership (other kind)

user_sees: 'This receipt is not for a membership, so no dues change.'
must_not: The dues sentence shown

user_sees: 'Receipt cancelled.'
must_not: Any member’s dues changed

start: Cancel-receipt sheet open; then the same receipt as staff; then with no internet

user_sees: The 'Cancel receipt' button stays unpressable
must_not: A cancel saved with no real reason

user_sees: The sheet closes, the receipt is as before
must_not: The receipt cancelled
The typed reason saved

steps.action: Sign in as staff and open the same member and Money
user_sees: No 'Cancel receipt' button anywhere; Money shows only Dues
must_not: The desk cancelling a receipt it took
A staff request accepted by the server

steps.action: As owner with the internet off, look at the row
user_sees: 'Cancel receipt' cannot be used while offline
must_not: A cancel kept on the device and sent later

user_sees: The server's words in a banner, or 'Could not cancel this receipt. Please try again.'
The sheet stays open with the reason still typed
must_not: 'Receipt cancelled' shown for a failed cancel

start: A receipt that has just been cancelled

steps.action: Look at its row on the member page and in Money
user_sees: Amount struck through and faded, marked cancelled, with the reason
No 'Cancel receipt' button on it
must_not: A way to cancel it twice
A way to un-cancel it without a trace

steps.action: Take the same money again with Collect payment
user_sees: A NEW receipt number, higher than every earlier one
must_not: The cancelled number given out again

steps.action: Two owner devices cancel the same receipt with different reasons
user_sees: One cancel; the first reason stays; both screens agree after a refresh
must_not: The second reason overwriting the first
The amount added to dues twice

steps.action: Cancel the plan AFTER its receipt was cancelled
user_sees: The due that had come back is no longer chased
must_not: A reminder for it

start: Terms of use and the cancel sheet

steps.action: Read the promise 'Only the owner can cancel a receipt, with the true reason.' and try as staff
user_sees: No button, and the server refuses a direct try
must_not: Any staff path to a cancel

steps.action: Cancel a receipt, then look at where the reason shows
user_sees: The reason is kept with the receipt and shown to the gym’s owner
must_not: The reason shown to the member in the member app or on a shared receipt
A cancelled receipt still sendable to the member as a valid receipt
The cancelled receipt visible to another gym
